name: Miniature toggle switch (C&K 7101)
summary: Classic bat-handle on/on toggle switch. Its 1/4-40 bushing needs a 6.5 mm hole.
source: C&K 7000 series catalogue, 7101 SPDT: 1/4-40 UNS-2A bushing 0.350 in (8.9 mm) long, bat handle 0.420 in (10.7 mm) beyond it, case 0.270 x 0.500 in (6.9 x 12.7 mm) and 0.350 in (8.9 mm) deep with the terminals a further 0.185 in (4.7 mm). The 6.5 mm hole clears the 6.35 mm thread. MTS-102 copies use an M6 bushing, which fits the same hole.

electrical.note: With silver (Q) contacts: 5 A at 120 V AC or 28 V DC, 2 A at 250 V AC.
